sloka: ततः सूक्ष्माम्बरधरो ब्रह्ममावर्तयन्परम् ।कुशान्गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां प्रसज्य प्रययावथ ।। ७.१०९.४ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sūkṣmāmbaradharo brahmamāvartayanparam ।kuśāngṛhītvā pāṇibhyāṁ prasajya prayayāvatha ।। 7.109.4 ॥

translations.english: Then, wearing fine garments, meditating upon the supreme Brahman, and holding Kusa grass in his hands, he went forth.
